System design & behavioural · Microfrontends

How do you share common components and libraries between Microfrontends?

Answer

  • Shared design system / component library published as a versioned npm package (often in a monorepo with Nx/Turborepo + Storybook).
  • Module Federation shared config to share singletons like react, react-dom, react-router (same version, singleton: true) so they're loaded once.
  • Expose common components/utilities from a remote ("shared" app) and consume at runtime.
  • Shared design tokens/CSS variables for consistent styling.
  • Communication via props from the shell, custom events, or a small shared event bus — avoid tightly coupled global stores.
  • Semantic versioning and contracts to avoid breaking other teams.
